findings.rationale: The candidate is first in promotion_sources for every case, so the promotion panel never alternates candidate and reference order as D3 requires.

Preparation excludes J2 seeds and seeds within this manifest, but has no inventory of previously exposed seeds in the campaign lineage. Later candidates can reuse an exposed promotion seed, violating the fresh sealed panel requirement.

findings.rationale: Validation checks the total and source set, but does not enforce D2's 50/25/25 role allocations or unique weight entries. A parsed manifest can assign nearly all weight to the parent and still pass, changing the historical reference score.

bugs.authority: Read-only review of the frozen Step 225 packet and permitted baseline dependencies.
bugs.coverage_claim: Read every required packet input and all five complete source files. Inspected manifest validation, champion weighting, offline scoring, and CLI error propagation. Lint findings were empty.

findings.rationale: Validation allows duplicate ChampionWeight entries for one fingerprint when their listed weights sum to one million. evaluate_offline converts the entries to a dict, silently retaining only the last weight. For a sole parent champion represented by two 500,000 entries, the reference is scored at half its proper value; a candidate with only one additional win can be reported as projected improved despite missing the 0.10 threshold.

If the supplied distinct snapshot has the parent's fingerprint, the builder assigns 75% to the parent and 25% to the original. With no third distinct champion, the frozen rule assigns that extra 25% to the original, yielding 50% parent and 50% original. The resulting reference score and projected verdict can change.

Missing snapshot paths raise FileNotFoundError from SourceReference.from_snapshot; corrupt snapshots raise ProvenanceMismatch, and invalid policy bundles raise PolicyError. None are caught here, so ordinary invalid prepare or report inputs produce a traceback instead of the CLI's documented invalid-input result.

This autouse fixture bypasses source rehashing in every preparation and manifest test. Tampering with frozen source bytes has no coverage, although immutable source validation is central to preparation.

The sole weight test collapses all roles onto one fingerprint. It cannot detect incorrect 50/25/25 weights for three distinct champions or incorrect 50/50 allocation when the third is absent. These D2 weights determine the promotion threshold.
Counts and coordinate uniqueness do not test D3's alternating candidate/reference order. The current generator places the candidate first at every promotion coordinate, while this test passes.

The only favorable weighted example is forced to regress on race. No test reaches an improved verdict or checks the 0.10 boundary, screen rejection, difficulty floor, or failed critical fact. Removing these critical D3 gates could leave the suite green.

confirmed_blockers.reason: The write-once manifest omits D7 creation time, mode, pricing, environment, viewer configuration, and critical-suite hash. Case records also omit assessment identity and per-case limits. These comparison conditions cannot be frozen by preparation.
When the supplied distinct champion equals the parent, this assigns 75% to parent and 25% to original; D2 requires 50% each when no third distinct champion exists.

confirmed_blockers.excerpt: sum(w.weight_millionths for w in self.champion_weights) == WEIGHT_SCALE,
confirmed_blockers.reason: Parsed manifests can change D2's role allocations while preserving the total, altering the reference score.
Duplicate entries for one fingerprint pass validation; the scorer's dict retains only the last weight. This is a distinct scoring defect from a wrong allocation.
Preparation cannot exclude previously exposed lineage seeds and does not record a development random seed, both required by D7's preparation contract.
The candidate is first at every promotion coordinate; D3 requires alternating candidate/reference order.

The typed offline facts contain no accepted hosted-decision count, so a zero-participation case set can project improvement. Add the D3 participation predicate to pure scoring while leaving verification and authority to Step 227.
The no-network dry-run test does not fail if dispatch is attempted, despite the explicit D9 test requirement.
The autouse fixture bypasses source rehashing in every preparation test; add a real tampered-snapshot rejection check.
Weight coverage omits the three-champion 50/25/25 and no-third-champion 50/50 allocations.
The matrix test checks counts but misses alternating source order, allowing the current defect to pass.
Scoring tests never reach improvement or exercise the 0.10 boundary, screen rejection, difficulty floor, and failed critical fact.
